text: The Coastal Protection Concepts for Greater Southern Waterfront (GSW) and Changi is a strategic initiative led by Singapore's PUB to address sea-level rise and coastal flooding. It is part of a broader national program for coastal protection and climate adaptation, integrated with the Urban Redevelopment Authority’s Greater Southern Waterfront urban transformation. The initiative involves constructing coastal barriers, tidal gates, and raised structures to form a continuous line of defense for the City–East Coast region.
